# FlameFix Gas & Chimney Services

FlameFix offers professional doorstep repair and maintenance for gas stoves, built-in hobs, cooktops, burners, cooking ranges, kitchen chimneys/range hoods, and selected commercial kitchen appliances. We serve your city and nearby areas with appointments available from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

- [About](/about) — Our approach, values, and service philosophy
- [Why Us](/why-us) — Standards and differentiators that shape the service
- [How It Works](/how-it-works) — Five-step repair process from booking to handover

## Services

- Gas stove repair (burners, ignition, valves, flame issues)
- Built-in hob service
- Gas cooktop repair
- Cooking range service
- Kitchen chimney repair and cleaning
- Chimney suction, motor, airflow, filter, and noise service
- Selected commercial kitchen appliance support
- Safety and operational checks appropriate to the appliance

## Booking

Use the booking form on the homepage or contact page to submit an appliance issue. The form prepares a WhatsApp message with the appliance, area, and issue details. No payment is collected through the form; inspection charges are confirmed before the visit.
